digest.component_or_area: CI/CD workflow and pytest test selection
propositions: Nineteen OS/Python-invariant repository-policy assertions are redundantly executed across all four default-suite matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13) despite their inputs and expected results being immutable.
A new pytest marker `repo_policy` must be registered and applied to exactly the 19 inventoried function-level test nodes spanning seven mixed modules.
The Ubuntu 3.13 default-suite process must retain the marked nodes while the other three default cells (Ubuntu 3.11, 3.12, macOS 3.13) must exclude them via `and not repo_policy` selector.
No new CI job, runner, checkout, dependency install, pytest session, or test fixture should be added; the marked tests run in the existing Ubuntu 3.13 default process.
Unmarked runtime, subprocess, and behavioral tests in the seven mixed modules must retain their original default selection across all four matrix cells.
The workflow parity test must prove marked/non-marked partitioning, validate the four-cell matrix integrity, and confirm exactly two pytest sessions remain unchanged.
